desc:
Chewits Fruity Twists come in fresh, vibrant colours and are packed with delicious fruit flavour. They’re suitable for vegans and vegetarians. Share them with friends and family and embark on a flavour-filled adventure!

Chewits · Twists · Fruity
ingredients:
Fruity Flavoured Sweets

Ingredients: sugar, glucose-fructose syrup, WHEAT flour, corn starch, glucose syrup, palm fat, dextrose, apple juice concentrate, acidity regulator (citric acid), humectant (sorbitol syrup), flavourings, palm oil, coconut oil, emulsifier (mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids), fruit and vegetable juice concentrates (black carrot, hibiscus), colours (copper complexes of chlorophyllins, lutein).
